newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Chevron/NNPC upgrade Nigerian oil facilities.
newsitem.headline: Chevron/NNPC upgrade Nigerian oil facilities.

text.p: More than $200 million has been spent by the Chevron Corp and Nigerian National Petroleum Corp (NNPC) to upgrade oil production facilities, the News Agency of Nigeria (NAN) reported on Thursday.
It said the sum was spent on 12 out of 18 facilities scheduled for refurbishment under a seven-year programme.
Already in its fifth year, the refurbishment programme is due to be completed in 1998 to modernise the facilities and make them safer.
NAN said Chevron's Meren II production platform, shut on January 10 for refurbishment, was back in production following the successful completion of the refurbishment.
Facilities that were yet to benefit from the programme are Meren I, Okan, Utonana, Robertkiri and Parabe platforms, in addition to the Delta South water injection platforms.
